paper.title_en: Quantum Causal Compatibility from Spatiotemporal Correlations
paper.abstract_en: Which quantum causal structures can account for observed spatiotemporal correlations without access to an intervention-complete description of the underlying process? In particular, can such correlations distinguish a temporal chain, a common cause, and a common effect? Here, we address these questions using three-qubit pseudo-density operators constructed from experimentally accessible Pauli correlations. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for pseudo-Markov compatibility with the chain, fork, and collider structures by relaxing complete positivity while preserving the corresponding quantum Markov constraints. Despite their distinct causal mechanisms, all three pseudo-Markov compatibility problems reduce to linear feasibility tests, without requiring full-rank marginal states. We further establish a unified semidefinite-programming approach to physical realizability and quantify the minimum violation of complete positivity through Choi negativity. Using a two-parameter family of pseudo-density operators, we demonstrate that different causal structures admit overlapping yet non-nested sets of correlations. Our results show that quantum causal explanations need not be unique, but experimentally accessible correlations can nevertheless distinguish and exclude candidate causal structures.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文从实验可及的Pauli关联构造三量子比特赝密度算符，研究在无干预完备描述下量子因果结构对时空关联的可解释性，并给出链、叉、碰撞器结构的赝马尔可夫相容性充要条件与半定规划方法。属于引力量子基础与因果结构方向，理论构造和方法论均较扎实，虽为1天新文且零引用（中性），仍值得研究者点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 从时空关联看量子因果相容性
decision.abstract_zh: 在不具备对底层过程的干预完备描述的情况下，哪些量子因果结构能够解释观测到的时空关联？特别地，此类关联能否区分时间链、共同原因与共同结果？在此，我们利用由实验可及的Pauli关联构造的三量子比特赝密度算符来回答这些问题。我们通过放松完全正定性同时保留相应的量子马尔可夫约束，推导出与链、叉和碰撞器结构赝马尔可夫相容的充要条件。尽管三种因果机制各不相同，所有三个赝马尔可夫相容性问题都约化为线性可行性检验，且不要求满秩边缘态。我们进一步建立了物理可实现性的统一半定规划方法，并通过Choi负性量化完全正定性的最小违背。利用一个双参数赝密度算符族，我们证明不同因果结构允许重叠但非嵌套的关联集合。我们的结果表明，量子因果解释不必唯一，但实验可及的关联仍能区分并排除候选因果结构。
